name: Environment for Real-Time Programming
postCreateCommand: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y cmake openjdk-17-jdk && python -m pip install --upgrade pip && python -m pip install -r .devcontainer/requirements.txt && curl -Ls https://install.lf-lang.org | bash -s cli --prefix=/home/vscode/.local/ && echo 'export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"' >> ~/.bashrc && echo "alias ll='ls -alF'" >> ~/.bashrc && echo 'Devcontainer setup is complete!'
postStartCommand: echo 'Welcome to this Real-Time Systems Environment!' && echo '--- Versions ---' && cmake --version && java --version && lfc --version
